name: com.zrazu/domain-passport
title: ZRAZU domain passport
description: Domain passport: registrar, dates, registry statuses, nameservers, DNS and SSL state. No key.

tools.name: domain_passport
tools.description: Domain passport: who is the registrar, when the domain was registered and when it expires, registry statuses explained in plain language, when the name may become free, nameservers and the hosting/DNS/mail stack, and health of DNS, website SSL certificate and mail with ready fixes. Input: a domain name (kava.com.ua), a URL or an email address — the domain is extracted. If the name is not found, the answer is 'could not verify', never 'free'.

domain.description: Domain, URL or email, e.g. kava.com.ua

language.description: Language of explanations: 'en', 'uk' or 'ru'. Use the user's language.
